body.x: ANKER(www.ianker.com) presented supply battery 'POWER IQ™' at 'Showstoppers' of the 'CES 2014', the biggest IT appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.
It can be charged anywhere and rapidly. Protected against overvoltage, overcurrent, overheating or short circuits. All Apple and Android smartphones, tablets and other USB-charged devices.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance.More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
